## s08-v13 — argument map

The universe (viśvam) woven (umbhitaṃ) in Your self (bhavadātmani), shown (prakāśyate) outside (bahiḥ) by You alone (bhavataivāpi) — what stands firm-certain (yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ): may it now shine plain (tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām). Closing epistemology: woven in Him, shown by Him, certain — shine.

### Open
- Whether 'umbhitaṃ' means 'woven' or 'born' is unresolved.
- Whether 'dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ' modifies 'tat' or 'mahimā' is unresolved.
